content: Fast-alert niche: direct career-page/ATS monitoring beats aggregators. OpenJobRadar auto-detects ATS (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby +12), alerts within 24h. Scoutify monitors 8800+ pages across Greenhouse/Lever/Workday/Ashby with push notifications. Jobstrack alerts within minutes. Greenhouse native MyGreenhouse alerts only daily/weekly email. Aggregator RSS lag = hours. Speed (minutes vs hours/days) is the differentiator in this niche; batch daily digests are the incumbent baseline.
